title: Counselor Desk Reference: Patient Payment Plans Down Payment at Signing
content:
The desk sets the down payment at signing of a Patient Payment Plans agreement from the hardship approval and the late-fee record of the patient's Patient Financial Account.

**Rule.** The down payment at signing is 0.00 when the financial account holds a hardship approval above 0.00 whose approved-through date is on or after the signing date and shows no late fee posted less than 12 whole months before the signing date. It is half of the tier's down payment percentage of the enrolled charges, rounded half up to the cent and with no minimum, when the account holds no hardship approval (an approved percentage of 0.00) and shows no such late fee. In every other case it is the tier's down payment percentage of the enrolled charges, rounded half up to the cent, but not less than the tier's minimum down payment.

**Terms.** *Enrolled charges* are the plan's initial enrollments and add-ons, the setup fee excluded. The tier's down payment percentage and minimum down payment are the figures of the fee and installment schedule for the tier being signed.

**Records read.** On the Patient Financial Account: the approved hardship percentage, the approved-through date, and late fees by posting date.

| Hardship approval on the account | Late fee posted less than 12 whole months before signing | Down payment at signing |
|---|---|---|
| Above 0.00, approved-through on or after the signing date | None | 0.00 |
| Above 0.00, approved-through on or after the signing date | One or more | Full percentage, not less than the tier minimum |
| Above 0.00, approved-through before the signing date | None | Full percentage, not less than the tier minimum |
| Above 0.00, approved-through before the signing date | One or more | Full percentage, not less than the tier minimum |
| 0.00 (no approval) | None | Half the percentage, no minimum |
| 0.00 (no approval) | One or more | Full percentage, not less than the tier minimum |

**Figures (hypothetical tier with a down payment percentage of 10.00 and a minimum down payment of 100.00).**

| Enrolled charges | Current approval, no late fee | No approval, no late fee | Any other case |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3,000.00 | 0.00 | 150.00 | 300.00 |
| 800.00 | 0.00 | 40.00 | 100.00 |

In the second row, half the percentage gives 40.00 with no minimum applied, while the full percentage gives 80.00 and is raised to 100.00.
